segments.text: Consider the way and course you have taken, since you came into the world; proceeding from iniquity to iniquity. What Command of God have you not violated a thousand times over? What sin is committed in the world, that you are not one way or other guilty of before God? How many secret sins are upon your score, unknown to the most intimate Friend you have in the world? Either this guilt must be separated from your souls, or your souls from God to all eternity.
